Good questions.
Honest answers.

Is this an actual business?+

This is a fictional brand and a satire of internet hustle culture. There are no sales, revenue claims, paying clients, or paid services here. The downloads are real, free creative demos.

Can I actually download something?+

Yes. Explore a product to download an original SVG logo, a 24-caption text pack, or a short digital playbook. The brand lab also exports a custom SVG. No account or payment needed.

Is the brand lab powered by live AI?+

The brand lab uses a small, browser-based template generator. It does not call an AI service or send your inputs to a server. Pick a mood, enter a name, and get a logo and caption instantly.

Will this make me internet rich?+

It will make you the owner of a file. Everything after that requires an actual idea, useful work, and probably fewer motivational posts. No earnings are promised.

Can I use the demo files?+

You can edit and use the original demo designs and text for personal or commercial projects. They are non-exclusive and have not been checked for trademark availability. A logo download does not register a business or a trademark.
